description.zh:
是否删除资源上全部的标签。当请求中未设置TagKey时，该参数才有效。默认值：false。可选值：

- true

- false
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resources. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey is not specified. Default value: false. Valid values:

- true

- false

description.zh:
资源类型。可能的值：

- service：服务。

- serviceinstance：服务实例。
- artifact： 部署物
description.en:
The resource type. Valid values:

- service: a service.

- serviceinstance: a service instance.

- artifact: an artifact.
The tag keys of the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier un-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type service --resource-id r-xxx --all false --tag-key Key1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier UnTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'r-xxx' --TagKey.1 Key1 --ResourceType service --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
